'''Arthur Pentland Dempster''' (October 8, 1929 – January 30, 2026) was an American{{cn|date=February 2026}} mathematician who was professor emeritus in the [[Harvard University]] department of statistics. He was one of four faculty members composing the department when it was founded in 1957.<ref>{{cite LCAuth |id=n88662525}}</ref>

== Life and career ==
Dempster received his B.A. in mathematics and physics (1952) and M.A. in mathematics (1953), both from the [[University of Toronto]]. He obtained his Ph.D. in mathematical statistics from [[Princeton University]] in 1956. His thesis, titled ''The two-sample multivariate problem in the degenerate case'', was written under the supervision of [[John Tukey]].

Dempster died on January 30, 2026, at the age of 96.<ref>[https://www.keefefuneralhome.com/memorials/arthur-p-dempster/5682528/ Arthur P. Dempster]</ref>

== Academic works ==
Among his contributions to statistics are the initial theory that was expanded into the [[Dempster–Shafer theory]] with [[Glenn Shafer]], and the [[expectation-maximization algorithm|expectation-maximization (EM) algorithm]].

== Honors and awards ==
Dempster was a [[William Lowell Putnam Mathematical Competition|Putnam Fellow]] in 1951.<ref name="MMA">{{cite web|title=Putnam Competition Individual and Team Winners |url=http://www.maa.org/programs/maa-awards/putnam-competition-individual-and-team-winners |publisher=[[Mathematical Association of America]]|access-date=December 10, 2021}}</ref> He was elected as an [[American Statistical Association]] Fellow in 1964,<ref name=asa /> an [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]] Fellow in 1963,<ref name=ims /> and an [[American Academy of Arts and Sciences]] Fellow in 1997.<ref>{{cite journal|jstor=3786119|title=List of Members by Classes September 1, 1997|journal=Records of the Academy (American Academy of Arts and Sciences)|year=1996|issue=1996/1997|pages=56–128}}</ref> In 2009 he received a honorary doctorate from [[Prague University of Economics and Business]].<ref>{{Cite news |date=2009-10-08 |title=The VŠE awarded A. P. Dempster and G. Shafer honorary doctorate |url=https://www.vse.cz/english/press-releases/the-vse-awarded-a-p-dempster-and-g-shafer-honorary-doctorate/ |url-status=live |access-date=2026-09-08}}</ref>
